metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in Etosha Pan decrease from mid-January, 2020 to around late August, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking: "Does the surface water extent in Etosha Pan decrease from mid-January, 2020 to around late August, 2020?" I need to: 1. Find a way to measure surface water extent 2. Compare between two time periods: mid-January 2020 and late August 2020 3. Provide evidence and output the appropriate tag Approach: 1. Geometry: Etosha Pan in Namibia. I'll use a polygon covering the area. 2. Data: I can use Sentinel-2 for water detection. The Modified Normalized Difference Water Index (MNDWI) is good for detecting water bodies. 3. Time periods: - Period 1: 2020-01-10 to 2020-01-20 (mid-January) - Period 2: 2020-08-20 to 2020-08-30 (late August) 4. Process: For each period: - Get Sentinel-2 images - Apply cloud masking - Calculate MNDWI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) where Green is band 3 and SWIR is band 11 - Threshold MNDWI > 0 to identify water pixels - Count water pixels in the region - Compare counts between periods 5. Output: If water pixel count decreases from Jan to Aug, answer A (Yes), otherwise B (No). Considerations: - Need to check if collections are empty (C1) - Need to check if valid pixels exist after masking (C2) - Need to validate calculations (C3) - Use appropriate scale for reduceRegion (3000m to avoid timeout) Structure: 1. Define geometry for Etosha Pan 2. Define time periods 3. Get Sentinel-2 collections for each period 4. Check collection sizes 5. Apply cloud masking and calculate water extent 6. Count water pixels 7. Compare and output answer ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Etosha Pan bounding box (approximate) var etoshaPan = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [15.5, -18.8], [16.5, -18.8], [16.5, -19.2], [15.5, -19.2] ]); // Time periods var janPeriod = ee.DateRange('2020-01-10', '2020-01-20'); var augPeriod = ee.DateRange('2020-08-20', '2020-08-30'); // 2. Data Acquisition // Function to get cloud-masked Sentinel-2 images function getS2Collection(dateRange, geometry) { var collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(dateRange.start(), dateRange.end()); // Cloud masking using QA60 band function maskClouds(image) { var qa = image.select('QA60'); var cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; var cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; var mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } return collection.map(maskClouds); } // Get collections for both periods var janCollection = getS2Collection(janPeriod, etoshaPan); var augCollection = getS2Collection(augPeriod, etoshaPan); // Check collection sizes var janSize = janCollection.size().getInfo(); var augSize = augCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log('Jan 2020 Images:', janSize); console.log('Aug 2020 Images:', augSize); // If either collection is empty, try fallback or output C1 if (janSize === 0 || augSize === 0) { console.log('Missing data in one or both periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate water extent for each period // Function to calculate water extent from a collection function calculateWaterExtent(collection, geometry, periodName) { // Create median composite var composite = collection.median(); // Calculate MNDWI (Modified Normalized Difference Water Index) // MNDWI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) var mndwi = composite.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('MNDWI'); // Water mask (MNDWI > 0 indicates water) var waterMask = mndwi.gt(0); // Count water pixels var waterCount = waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 3000, // Using 3km scale to avoid timeout maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI'); // Get total valid pixels var validPixels = waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI'); return { waterCount: waterCount.getInfo(), validPixels: validPixels.getInfo(), mndwi: mndwi, waterMask: waterMask }; } // Calculate for January var janResult = calculateWaterExtent(janCollection, etoshaPan, 'January'); var augResult = calculateWaterExtent(augCollection, etoshaPan, 'August'); console.log('Jan 2020 Water Pixels:', janResult.waterCount); console.log('Jan 2020 Valid Pixels:', janResult.validPixels); console.log('Aug 2020 Water Pixels:', augResult.waterCount); console.log('Aug 2020 Valid Pixels:', augResult.validPixels); // Check for no valid pixels (C2) if (janResult.validPixels === 0 || augResult.validPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Check for calculation failures (C3) if (janResult.waterCount === null || augResult.waterCount === null || isNaN(janResult.waterCount) || isNaN(augResult.waterCount)) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 4. Compare and output answer var waterDecrease = augResult.waterCount < janResult.waterCount; console.log('Water extent change: Jan =', janResult.waterCount.toFixed(0), 'Aug =', augResult.waterCount.toFixed(0)); console.log('Decrease?', waterDecrease); if (waterDecrease) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
